reviews.reason: The added (3,0) and (1,+1) probes are nondynamical, are excluded from the Weyl spectrum and determinants, and leave the connection-background anomaly subalgebra unchanged. This consumer fixes an SU(3)-singlet charged threshold sector with a neutral mass partner; it does not assert a faithful H action on that sector alone. Its gamma5=-i gamma^0 gamma^1 gamma^2 gamma^3, D=d+iB, inverse local U(1) action and component dimensions agree with the current supplier. Neither its threshold premise nor its restricted counterterm convention is invalidated.

The Definition uses one local monopole duality frame, positive g_D and opposite dual electric charges. Exchanging the local electric coordinate to a_D can use the determinant-one matrix ((0,-1),(1,0)), giving tau_D=-1/tau and Im(tau_D)>0. The supplier's symplectic restriction therefore invalidates no field, potential or local-coordinate clause. The frozen metric and linear-u approximation remain explicit extra model choices; vortex existence and global continuation remain unasserted.

The affected Definition clause identifies original electric flux with the dual magnetic flux in an adopted fixed frame. Its transverse orientation, D_i=partial_i-i Atilde_i on M, opposite winding on Mtilde, and uniform angular boundary condition fix the sign of that flux. No determinant-minus-one frame transformation is invoked. Restricting supplier frame changes to SL(2,Z) preserves this local flux dictionary, energy and conditional vacuum data, without adding vortex existence or stationarity.

The Postulate already imposes gamma_m dot gamma_e=1 and uses the period column (a_D,a). Its three displayed monodromies all have determinant one; M_+ M_-=M_infinity. Its charge-period scalar is invariant when charge rows transform by the inverse matrix as the repaired supplier requires. The source-proposed period family, nonzero local monopole derivative and inverse u(A_D) remain adopted inputs. No curve, central-charge normalization, physical scope or approximation clause needs correction.

This Definition uses the unchanged local pairing Z_SW=n_e a+n_m a_D and explicitly supplies DSZ=2(n_m n'_e-n_e n'_m), twice the supplier's orientation form. Both are preserved by determinant-one basis changes with inverse charge rows; DSZ(gamma_m,gamma_d)=2 remains correct. The already repaired grading and supercharge/actual-adjoint invariance of the nonzero BPS subspace is preserved. Supplied rest fibers, gap, trace-class insertion and Hilbert basis remain conditional data with AC_omega only; the frame repair adds no state-existence or index-identification claim.

The affected paragraph imports the corrected source-labelled R bundle and R^Q bilinear without specifying an inconsistent quaternion multiplication side. Its H=delta_gauge(a0)-L_v^lift-delta_R and affine ghost rule agree with the supplier's retained total square. The supplied smooth chart and Q(Phi*)=0 give D^2=dH by taking the linear Taylor part; D commutes with its square, so ker(dH) remains a differential domain. These uses do not depend on the former factor misidentification; no ellipticity, regulator existence or continuum measure is inferred.
